name: Mango Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Mango Ice Cream: Milk and Milk Solids, Mango Pulp (20%), Maltitol, Fructooligosaccharides, Erythritol, Whey Protein Concentrate, Permitted Emulsifying (E471) and Stabilising (E477, E412, E466, E407, E415, E410) Agents, Stevia. Contains permitted natural colour(s) and nature identical flavouring substance (Mango). Made in a facility that also processes nuts. Allergens: Contains Milk. May contain Soy.
